name: 45387 · Yellow Spgs, OH
findings: ZIP 45387 (Yellow Spgs) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45387 (Yellow Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45387 (Yellow Spgs) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
